x87_dc_sites.note: Multiplies pos.x + prev.x in ST1 by 0.5 in ST0 while retaining 0.5 in ST0 to scale mid.y (0070c4ed), mid.z (0070c4fd), and 0.5*segLen + 2*blastRadius (0070c51e).

Divides nx in ST1 by 32767.0 (case 10) or 65535.0 (case 12) in ST0 while retaining the divisor in ST0 to divide ny (0070ff65) and nz (0070ff6b FDIVR). Note: 6 dc ff sites from 0071005c through 0071008c are switch jump-table data words (0x0070ffdc).
Divides u in ST1 by 32767.0 (case 9) or 65535.0 (case 11) in ST0 while retaining the divisor in ST0 to divide v (00710190) and the unused third lane (00710196 FDIVR).
